items.html: And we shall further explain thirteen other aspects that are in the skull itself, which are the secret of the twelve letters that are in the three Names of YHVH that are in the three aspects of this aforementioned skull. And likewise the thirteen corrections of the Mocha, which are within the Mocha itself, apart from the thirteen corrections of the beard that are also drawn from it, except that they are outside of it. And also in the Avira there are thirteen others of its own.
